articles.title: BSF Jawans Refuse to Board Dilapidated Train for Amarnath Yatra Duty, 4 Railway Officers Suspended
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Guwahati: Around 1200 BSF jawans, deployed for Amarnath Yatra duty, refused to board a severely dilapidated train provided by the Railways. The train reportedly had broken windows, damaged doors, unusable toilets, and faulty electrical fittings.

body.html:
Guwahati: Around 1200 BSF jawans, deployed for Amarnath Yatra duty, refused to board a severely dilapidated train provided by the Railways. The train reportedly had broken windows, damaged doors, unusable toilets, and faulty electrical fittings.

After waiting for nearly four days, the jawans were finally allotted a replacement train. Following the incident, four railway officers have been suspended. The issue has raised serious questions about the treatment of security personnel on duty.

articles.title: ‘Model Chai Wali’ Beaten by Cops at Midnight in Lucknow, Video Goes Viral — Public Outrage Follows
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow: A shocking incident has surfaced from the city, where Simran Gupta, popularly known as ‘Model Chai Wali’, was allegedly assaulted and misbehaved with by police officers at midnight. The incident, caught on video, has gone viral and sparked widespread outrage.

body.html:
Lucknow: A shocking incident has surfaced from the city, where Simran Gupta, popularly known as ‘Model Chai Wali’, was allegedly assaulted and misbehaved with by police officers at midnight. The incident, caught on video, has gone viral and sparked widespread outrage.

Around 12 AM on Sunday, police from Madiyanv station reportedly reached Simran’s tea stall and began harassing her for keeping it open late. Simran claims she was abused, manhandled, and even had her clothes pulled by a woman constable. In the viral video, a female cop is seen dragging Simran as she screams in protest.

Simran has accused the police of demanding illegal money, saying the assault began when she refused to pay. Meanwhile, police claim action was taken for operating beyond allowed hours.

Simran, a former model and ‘Miss Gorakhpur’ titleholder, had turned to selling tea after her father fell ill. She now supports her family through her earnings.

Following the incident, Simran has announced legal action. Public outrage is growing online under the hashtag #JusticeForSimran.

articles.title: SHOCKING: Rajasthan Deputy SP Caught on Camera Striking Woman Constable During Congress Protest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing Deputy SP Sunil Jhajharia allegedly hitting a woman constable has gone viral on social media from Churu district, Rajasthan. The incident occurred on Monday during a Congress demonstration at the District Collectorate.

body.html:
A video showing Deputy SP Sunil Jhajharia allegedly hitting a woman constable has gone viral on social media from Churu district, Rajasthan. The incident occurred on Monday during a Congress demonstration at the District Collectorate.

The footage shows the senior officer striking the woman constable on her back whilst telling her to move during crowd control operations. Congress workers were attempting to forcefully enter the collectorate premises when the incident took place.

Several Congress leaders including state vice-president Rafiq Mandliya, district president Indraj Khichad, and Sujangarh MLA Manoj Meghwal were present during the protest rally.

However, Churu SP Jai Yadav has dismissed the video as "fake," claiming it has been edited. Kotwali police station in-charge Sukhram Chotiya stated that the original video was manipulated before being circulated on social media.

Police have registered a case under IT Act sections and launched an investigation into the viral video.
